name: Card Servicing
description: Self-service balance, statement, limit and payment servicing for cardholders.

name: Collections Workspace
description: Agent workspace for arrears treatment and payment arrangements.

name: Customer 360
description: Curated single view of the customer for analytics and servicing.

name: Dispute Management
description: Chargeback and dispute handling, bought rather than built.

name: Customer Identity Service
description: Authentication, session and identity proofing for every customer channel.

name: Identity Document Verification
description: Document and liveness verification at onboarding, bought rather than built. The identity service sends the captured document and selfie; the vendor calls back with the result. Restricted from the first byte, so the path to the vendor is private.

name: Installment Lending
description: Point-of-sale installment lending. New product, onboarding onto the AWS landing zone in eu-west-2, integrating with the existing card ledger for disbursement and with the warehouse for regulatory reporting.

name: Lending Portfolio Performance
description: Arrears, roll rates, vintage curves and payment behavior for point-of-sale finance, curated nightly from the product's own events into BigQuery and served to the lending analysts through Looker. The first data product on the Google Cloud side, in an analytics project of its own.

name: Merchant Portal
description: Where a merchant applies for an account, sees settlements and chargebacks, and downloads statements. Built in-house on the Azure landing zone, beside Rewards Redemption; the first product assembled from parts rather than built on a shape.

name: Open Banking Affordability
description: Affordability assessment from the shopper's own bank data, with consent, in the seconds a point-of-sale decision has. Bought rather than built; the vendor runs the open banking connections and the categorization, we send the consent and receive the assessment. Restricted from the first byte, so the path to the vendor is private.

name: Point-of-Sale Finance
description: Financing offered at a retailer's checkout. The dealer or merchant starts the application in their own system, the shopper completes it on their phone, and the decision comes back before the sale closes. Built in-house on the Google Cloud landing zone, the first product to land there.

name: Rewards Redemption
description: Cardholders browse the rewards catalog and redeem points for statement credit, gift cards and merchandise. Built in-house on the Azure landing zone; a redemption is confirmed in the response and fulfilled afterward by a worker consuming the product's own events.

name: NICE Actimize Screening
description: Sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening, bought rather than built. Called in line by the authorization switch at transaction time, with a nightly rescreen of the book and a return feed for reconciliation and model risk.
